title: Lucia Šušková
text: Lucia Šušková (born 27 March 1993) is a Slovak footballer who plays as a midfielder. She has also played for Žirafa Žilina and Slovan Bratislava in Slovakia's First League, FC Neunkirch in Switzerland's Nationalliga A, TS Mitech Żywiec and Czarni Sosnowiec in the Polish Ekstraliga, and was a member of the Slovak national team.
